clips.title: The story
paras: In Redridge, an adventurer finds a gnoll pendant and hears a voice through it. The voice belongs to Theocritus, High Mage of Tower of Azora, who has intercepted the gnolls' mystical network and urgently asks for the pendant to study.

Across the Redridge Mountains, travelers fighting the savage Shadowhide gnolls sometimes find a Shadowhide Pendant. Touching the enchanted trinket brings a calm, distant voice instead of barking or curses. The speaker is Theocritus, a human mage at Tower of Azora, across the border in Elwynn Forest. His message comes from long research into breaking the dark sorceries that direct the gnoll packs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Do not be alarmed. I am Theocritus, High Mage of Tower Azora in Elwynn Forest. The pendant you are holding is a method of communication between the Shadowhide Gnolls and their master, Morganth.
Through months of research, I believe I too can communicate through these pendants. If you can hear this message, then my spell was a success.
Bring me this pendant and I will reward you for the service.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I spoke to you through a pendant, you say? Hmm...give it to me, so that I might study it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have my gratitude, friend. I sent that message to the Shadowhide Pendants weeks ago and had believed it a failure. But it seems the spell did reach at least some pendants, after a significant delay.
In time I hope to learn how to send an attack through the pendants, to immobilize any Shadowhide Gnolls who wear them.
But before that is possible, I'm afraid that much more research is required.
